Feature: User Authentication

  Background:
    Given the user is on the registration page

  Scenario: User registers successfully with valid details
    When the user enters a valid email "testuser@example.com"
    And the user enters a password "TestPass123"
    And the user submits the registration form
    Then the user receives a confirmation email
    And the user can log in after confirming the email

  Scenario: User attempts to register with an invalid email format
    When the user enters an invalid email "invalidemail"
    And the user enters a password "TestPass123"
    And the user submits the registration form
    Then an error message "Invalid email format" is displayed

  Scenario: User attempts to register with a password that is too short
    When the user enters a valid email "testuser@example.com"
    And the user enters a password "Test123"
    And the user submits the registration form
    Then an error message "Password must be at least 8 characters" is displayed

  Scenario: User logs in successfully with valid credentials
    Given the user has registered and confirmed their email
    When the user navigates to the login page
    And the user enters valid email "testuser@example.com"
    And the user enters password "TestPass123"
    And the user submits the login form
    Then the user is redirected to the dashboard

  Scenario: User attempts to log in with an incorrect password
    Given the user has registered and confirmed their email
    When the user navigates to the login page
    And the user enters valid email "testuser@example.com"
    And the user enters an incorrect password "WrongPassword"
    And the user submits the login form
    Then an error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed

  Scenario: User resets forgotten password
    Given the user has a registered email
    When the user navigates to the password reset page
    And the user enters their registered email
    And the user submits the request
    Then the user receives a reset link via email

Feature: Product Browsing

  Background:
    Given the user is logged in

  Scenario: User views the product listing page
    When the user navigates to the product listing page
    Then all products are displayed correctly with pagination

  Scenario: User searches for a product by name
    Given products with name "Laptop" exist
    When the user enters "Laptop" in the search bar
    And the user submits the search
    Then only products with "Laptop" in name should display

  Scenario: User views details of a selected product
    Given a product exists
    When the user clicks on the product
    Then the product details page should load
    And it should show description, specifications, price, and rating

Feature: Shopping Cart

  Background:
    Given the user is logged in

  Scenario: User adds a product to their shopping cart
    Given the user is viewing a product
    When the user clicks "Add to Cart"
    Then the product is added to the cart
    And a success message "Product added to cart" is displayed

  Scenario: User views their shopping cart
    Given the user has items in their cart
    When the user navigates to the cart page
    Then all items in the cart are displayed with quantity and price

  Scenario: User modifies the quantity of an item in their cart
    Given the user is on the cart page
    When the user changes the quantity of a product
    And the user clicks "Update"
    Then the subtotal and total amount should recalculate

  Scenario: User removes an item from their shopping cart
    Given the user is on the cart page
    When the user clicks "Remove" for a product
    Then the product is removed from the cart
    And the cart count should decrease

Feature: Checkout

  Background:
    Given the user has items in their cart

  Scenario: User enters shipping address during checkout
    When the user clicks "Proceed to Checkout"
    And the user enters shipping address details
    And the user submits the address form

Feature: User Authentication

  Scenario: User logs in with valid credentials
    Given the user has a registered account with email "testuser@example.com"
    And the user has confirmed the email
    When the user navigates to the login page

    And the user enters the password "TestPass123"

    Given the user has an active order
    When the user navigates to the order details page
